verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.context.dev/llms.txt indexing the Markdown docs, and a second llms.txt exists at www.context.dev. Agent-oriented resources also include .md doc pages, an agent skill that teaches coding agents to use the API, and an agent auth flow (auth.md). Missing for 10: independent or community reports of agents actually consuming these docs successfully.
